reason: Value/transfer lens: the gain is too small to measure, and a node-count artefact can swamp it. (1) Metric ceiling: score = J*(1-0.1*dN/N_est) + 0.1*div_J. A detection-map change reaches only a_never (1,907 FN x 7.37e-6 = +0.0141, exp39 lab). The 167 44b6 misses among them are merged neighbours ~7 um apart; a 2x2-mean-blurred view makes those worse, not better. Divisions: none, since no division term is targeted. (2) The design dilutes its own mechanism. As a 9th view at weight 1/9, the pixel-noise variance of each model's map falls only to (8/9)^2+(1/9)^2 = 0.80 (SD -10%). An equal-weight 2-phase average would reach 0.50. So H2 buys ~0.4x the de-noising of a full polyphase. That full polyphase is itself at most tempfuse-class, and tempfuse was refuted at +0.0008 central. Each peak moves by (1/9)(phase-base): that reshuffles peaks near 0.965 in both directions, so the net recall gain is second-order. Pixel noise is also a minor part of why faint nuclei are missed; appearance and depth bias are shared by both phases. Central standalone ~+0.0003 (range -0.001..+0.001). The bundle with tempfuse is sub-additive: same faint pool, and one count-guard budget where every admitted peak evicts one. That gives ~+0.0008..+0.001, not +0.001..+0.0015. (3) Node multiplier: +1% nodes = -0.00093 (break-even 126 FN per 1%). The proposed guard tolerance (+-1%) therefore allows +-0.0009 of multiplier movement, ~3x the expected edge effect (~40 FN). Nodes from readmit, gapfill, linefit and short-track are not guarded at all. Any lab or LB delta of this size cannot be told apart from a multiplier artefact. (4) Transfer and validation: the train-clip lab is invalid (phase (0,0) is memorised on all 199 videos: io.py strided training, and predict l.209-222 does the same). The 'honest' LOEO lab uses friend A's 0.86-recall primary. That has far more recall headroom than x138's pilkwang ensemble, so a +0.003 pass there would overstate x138. Its 12 videos are overlapping crops of one 44b6 recording, and friend A has not answered. The 'V1284 head and edge features byte-identical' claim holds only for the feature maps: the peak set and argmax positions that the head consumes do change. (5) Prior evidence: the detection-map-change class is 0/5 on our LB (z-flip -0.003/-0.009, axis-flip -0.001 against +0.021 local, secondary weight -0.002). The axis-flip view-set change on an unseen-embryo primary gave only +0.0007. With a 2-run LB SD of ~0.003, P(observed >= +0.002 | true 0) ~ 25%, so R4 would mostly adopt noise. (6) It is a closed line in disguise at the class level. The v2 polyphase was refuted as localisation, and 'more TTA views on the detection map' is the closed TTA class. Switching the aim to recall gives a new story, not a new measurable mechanism. (7) Cost coupling: +0.38 h pushes the forecast past the 8.0 h insertion gate. That forces moving DIVINS_DEADLINE_S later, which H1 itself says not to do (15-55:1 repair-vs-insertion trade), or else it eats part of the one confirmed LB gain (+0.001 insertion). Private: same mechanism, same order; the node-multiplier sign on unseen embryos is unknown. Expected value ~ +0.0002, below every gate we can resolve.
fix: Do not build it as a K4 rider. If agent hours truly remain after K3/K3b, the only defensible form is: (a) use the phase view only as an extra CANDIDATE POOL for readmit/gapfill (max or mean of base and phase restricted to lowdet peaks). The main det_logits and node set stay byte-identical, and there is no count guard or head-input change. (b) Give it EQUAL weight against the base map, not 1/9, if it is used at all. (c) Gate it on friend A's LOEO harness with arms decomposed into the edge-J term at matched final N_pred, |dN_final| <= 0.3%, >= +0.003 on edge-J alone, leak groups counted by recording. (d) Keep DIVINS_DEADLINE_S at 28800; drop it if the forecast then exceeds 8.0 h. Without friend A by 26 Sep 12:00 UTC, close it. Spend the agent hours on K3/K3b and F1/F2 finals hygiene instead.
realistic_gain: Public: ~+0.0003 alone (range -0.001..+0.001), ~+0.0008..+0.001 bundled with tempfuse; P(true bundle gain >= +0.002) ~0.05-0.10. Private: same order, with a node-multiplier sign risk of +-0.0009 at the +-1% guard. Below LB resolution (2-run SD ~0.003) and below the R4 +0.002 bar.
